company_description: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. provides hand tools, power tools, outdoor products, and related accessories in the United States, Canada, Other Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its Tools & Outdoor segment offers professional grade corded and cordless electric power tools and equipment, including drills, impact wrenches and drivers, grinders, saws, routers, concrete prep and placement tools, and sanders; pneumatic tools and fasteners, such as nail guns, nails, staplers and staples, and concrete and masonry anchors; corded and cordless electric power tools; household power tools, hand-held vacuums, and small appliances; leveling and layout tools, planes, hammers, demolition tools, clamps, vises, knives, saws, chisels, and industrial and automotive tools; drill, screwdriver, router bits, abrasives, saw blades, and threading products; tool boxes, sawhorses, medical cabinets, and engineered storage solutions; and electric and gas-powered lawn and garden products. This segment sells its products under the DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, CUB ADET, STANLEY, BLACK+DECKER, and HUSTLER brands through retailers, third-party distributors, independent dealers, and a direct sales force. risks.title: Government Litigation
risks.summary: The company faces government action from the CPSC regarding non-compliance with reporting deadlines for product recalls (tool bars, miter saws), with risk of referral to the DOJ and estimated civil penalty of approximately $32 million.
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing CPSC/DOJ action regarding reporting violations related to tool bar and miter saw recalls, recommended fine of approximately $32 million, potentially significant direct financial impact.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary: The company is subject to strict regulations regarding product safety and compliance with regulatory reporting requirements, with potential impact on financial results.
risks.score_rationale: Strict compliance required with product safety and reporting standards, risks of penalties and operational disruptions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: The company operates in highly competitive markets where brand, innovation and integrated solutions are key success factors, exposing its market share to competitive pressure.
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive markets (tools, outdoor products, assembly systems) based on innovation, brand and integrated solutions, requiring continuous investments.

risks.title: Geopolitics and Tariffs
risks.summary: The company operates in multiple countries with significant dependence on global supply chains, exposed to tariff, regulatory and geopolitical risks affecting production costs.
risks.score_rationale: Geographic exposure across 18 states and 21 countries, dependence on global supply chains, tariff and regulatory change risks, planning assumptions based on January 2026 tariff environment.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks related to its digital activities, global systems and connected solutions, with potential impact on financial results and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Growing exposure to cybersecurity risks with dependence on digital transformation and global distribution systems.

risks.title: Supply Chain
risks.summary: Supply chain transformation, including site closures, center of excellence creation and distribution network restructuring, creates temporary disruption risks.
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing supply chain transformation involving real estate portfolio rationalization, complexity reduction and contract manufacturer integration, disruption risks.
